seo.meta_title: What Are KFC's 11 Herbs and Spices?
seo.meta_description: KFC's 11 herbs and spices recipe is a closely guarded secret created by Colonel Sanders. Here's what's known and why it stays hidden.
seo.h1: What Are KFC's 11 Herbs and Spices?

question: What Are KFC's 11 Herbs and Spices?
quick_answer: KFC's '11 herbs and spices' is the secret seasoning blend Colonel Harland Sanders created for his fried chicken, and the exact recipe is one of the most closely guarded secrets in the food industry. KFC keeps the full formula confidential, so while people often guess common seasonings like pepper, paprika, garlic and herbs, the real, precise blend has never been officially confirmed.
key_facts: The blend was created by Colonel Harland Sanders
The exact recipe is a closely guarded trade secret
KFC has never officially confirmed the full list
Commonly guessed ingredients include pepper, paprika, garlic and salt
Security measures protect the original recipe

body.heading: A famous secret recipe
body.text: The '11 herbs and spices' is the seasoning mix Colonel Sanders developed for KFC's Original Recipe fried chicken. It is one of the best-known secret recipes in the world, and KFC treats it as a core trade secret rather than public information.

body.heading: Why it stays hidden
body.text: KFC protects the recipe carefully. The company has described keeping the original handwritten formula secured, and it is said that no single supplier knows the whole blend, with different parts mixed separately. This secrecy is part of the brand's marketing as well as its recipe protection.

body.heading: What people think is in it
body.text: Over the years there have been many guesses and leaked lists claiming to reveal the blend, often including everyday seasonings like black and white pepper, paprika, garlic, salt and various herbs. KFC has not officially confirmed any of these, so the precise, authentic 11-ingredient mix remains unverified.

faqs.q: Does KFC reveal its 11 herbs and spices?
faqs.a: No. KFC keeps the exact recipe a closely guarded secret and has never officially confirmed the full list of ingredients.
Colonel Harland Sanders created the 11 herbs and spices blend for KFC's Original Recipe fried chicken.

faqs.q: What ingredients are rumored to be in it?
faqs.a: Common guesses include black and white pepper, paprika, garlic, salt and various herbs, but none of these are officially confirmed by KFC.
